profileContract.rationale: One proxy owns network authority, backend mods own world actions, and proxy-owned SQLite supplies shared durable state. Backend journals and a separate central audit dataset isolate high-volume capture and bounded investigation from login and teleport authority.
Canonical command ownership, replay rejection, ordered revisions, idempotent writes and transfer receipts prevent duplicate or contradictory outcomes.
The bridge, storage and server transfers need bounded failure, no false success and actionable recovery.

Standalone Forge deployment has no external proxy adapter dependency. The separately selected network profile uses compatibility-validated transfers with the pinned external reset-capable client, with early safe refusal of missing capability and incompatible or unknown relations. No SEF client or launcher project is added.

The owner approved a pinned external client reset adapter for the selected Forge proxy profile, while standalone SEF runs without Velocity, Ambassador, ProxyCompatibleForge or client reset. Missing capability and incompatible or unknown network profiles refuse before movement. All command output follows the supplied rich-chat reference, and RTP exposes local/proxy modes without custom client interfaces.
Two product branch endpoints, sequential phase PRs, paired artifact verification, rollback and operator documentation. Production publication excluded.
Reject client-forged and replayed administration, bind actors and servers, and protect private moderation and vanished presence.

Bans, absolute mute expiry, vanish, server-bound homes, durable operations and migration require explicit schemas and restart convergence. Audit history additionally requires immutable identities, causal confidence, actual outcomes, durable and query-visible watermarks, and explicit uncertain tails. Audit restoration jobs, independent parent/subcell cycles, recent landings, configuration epochs and destination reservations require crash-safe state.

Use real signed-chat, transfer, restart and visibility paths with headless node-1 and a silent verified laptop client. Includes full audit/restoration conservation, dual-SQL engines, rich-chat rendering/actions and hierarchical RTP invariants plus real landings.
Backend, proxy, protocol, configuration, data and paired artifacts require separate pinned versions.

Use node-1 only for headless workloads and verified silent laptop clients for named interaction and visibility assertions, with verified cleanup.
mandatoryRequirements.source: SRC-001, SRC-004 and owner host policies
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Deliver separate standalone Forge and Ambassador-network installation guides, plus exact server registration, forwarding, security, commands, permissions, configuration, migration, backup, rollback and compatibility documentation, including artifact pairing and protocol mismatch guidance. Make optional external adapter placement, the verified SEF Velocity companion download and operator-only missing-companion guidance explicit.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Add a comprehensive Forge-native CoreProtect-style activity history module. Define and prove capture for server-observable gameplay, block and block-entity changes, containers and item flows, natural and automated changes, players and entities, interactions, commands and communications, administration and network lifecycle. Maintain an action-level capture matrix, mod adapter contracts, causal attribution and explicit observable coverage gaps without promising invisible mod internals or silently sampling required events. Include accepted authoritative movement changes without silent sampling. Publish the exact fidelity and instrumentation boundary, not a claim of recording every internal simulation state.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Persist audit events with stable backend/world/session identity, commit-time before and after state where applicable, monotonic ordering, actor/cause confidence, durable local journals, deduplicated central ingestion, crash recovery and explicit gap or completeness state. Keep high-volume history isolated from low-volume network authority and preserve accurate offline-backend investigations. Support MySQL and MariaDB for the central audit dataset, with MySQL as the primary target and engine-specific migrations, backup and integration verification.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Provide permission-controlled textual inspection, paginated lookup and export filtered by actor, server, dimension/world, location/radius, time, event kind, item/block/entity, cause and correlation. Support cross-server investigations and offline backend history with explicit pending-ingestion completeness watermarks, query limits and access auditing, without adding client code or menus.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Capture full public/private message text and command arguments with credential redaction before every sink, separately permissioned sensitive reads, configurable normal retention defaulting to manual purge, and availability-first oldest-local-segment rotation under capacity exhaustion. Explicitly report lost intervals and affected completeness watermarks. Provide storage health, backups, controlled purge, capacity planning and documented recovery. Audit administration is itself recorded.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Prove audit event coverage and state conservation on vanilla and representative modded real paths, including hoppers/machines, fake players, canceled actions, explosions, mixed cause chains, before/after snapshots, duplicate callbacks, crash boundaries, database outage, disk pressure, restart ingestion, heavy queries and owner-approved mutation recovery. Publish measured overhead and exact coverage limitations.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Implement CoreProtect-style previewed rollback, restore and undo for the declared reversible event types, with precise filters, before-image integrity, permissions, confirmation, live-state and revision conflict checks, bounded server-thread mutation, inventory duplication prevention, durable job progress, cancellation, crash recovery and auditable outcomes. Unsupported opaque state is refused explicitly rather than represented as restored.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Produce and satisfy a versioned CoreProtect feature/action/API parity inventory covering capture, inspection, queries, filters, pagination, summaries, rollback, restore, undo, preview, purge, supported extension hooks and operational behavior. Map applicable functions to Forge-native equivalents; document platform-only incompatibilities and technical unknowns without silently dropping feasible mandatory behavior. Additional network and movement investigation capability is included by the owner's existing request.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Redesign every retained and new SEF command response using the supplied HuskHomes visual style. Use a shared localized presentation contract for backend and proxy, calm semantic colors, readable labels and values, brackets, check/cross icons, grouped actions, hover explanations, safe click actions and pagination. Prevent untrusted markup/command injection, bind sensitive actions to current authority and target state, confirm destructive actions, and provide readable console and accessibility fallbacks without custom client installation.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Expose audit capacity and loss incidents to all authorized operators/admins through a restricted command display and optional configured Discord delivery. Warn before exhaustion, distinguish local spool and central SQL failures, deduplicate/rate-limit and recover notifications, preserve credentials, and retain honest incident/gap visibility even when Discord is unavailable. Do not automatically stop the server or erase unrelated data.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Implement persisted per-world hierarchical random-without-replacement grids with configurable world bounds and parent layout. Every parent appears once per completed parent cycle, with no immediate same-parent cycle-boundary repeat. Each parent's independently shuffled subcell cycle survives parent reshuffles. Coordinates remain random within the chosen subcell. The six-parent, 20-by-20 subcell example has 2400 distinct subcells. Persist epochs and selection/reservation state and reject invalid or impossible layouts without silent rule changes. Consume a parent and subcell turn only on confirmed successful landing. Provisional reservations fence concurrent use; confirmed failures release them, while uncertain arrivals remain quarantined until reconciled.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Enforce configurable minimum landing separation from online players, active destination reservations and recent landings within the same destination world, plus world border, claims, biome/surface/hazard and chunk readiness safety. Use atomic concurrent reservations and final revalidation. Unsatisfiable requests receive a brief bounded queue or explicit unavailable result, never quiet section reuse or distance reduction. Define abort, disconnect, timeout, restart and cycle-boundary behavior and prove no duplication or stale-session teleport.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Provide local RTP independent of Velocity and optional proxy RTP that selects an eligible compatible backend before using its destination grid. Authenticate fresh telemetry for MSPT, spikes, capacity, incoming reservations, chunk work and prepared safe-location supply; separate world size from capacity. Reject stale/unready backends, prevent routing oscillation and stampedes, enforce destination-owned reservations and idempotent arrival, and retain ordinary permission, cooldown, warmup, cancellation, audit and recovery rules.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Deliver validated RTP configuration, controlled reload/migration of grid identities and bounds, permission-controlled diagnostics and allocation evidence, durable cycle/reservation recovery, bounded preparation and query work, deterministic property tests, real safe-landing and transfer tests, load/failure tests, and operator documentation. Verify both local and proxy mode and that child cycles do not reset with parent cycles.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Native backend and proxy adapters where the contract crosses platforms

mandatoryRequirements.summary: Provide editable main-config join, leave, first-time welcome and welcome-back message families with multiple variants and safe placeholders including {player_name}. Use the common HuskHomes-style native chat renderer, independently enabled bounded templates, documented audiences and variant policies, a typed placeholder catalog, durable UUID-based first/returning visit semantics, single local/network lifecycle ownership, transfer and reconnect deduplication, permission-aware vanish filtering, atomic validated reload with last-good preservation, restricted preview, migration, diagnostics and real local/network acceptance. Do not add a graphical editor, scripts, arbitrary console actions or a required client component.
mandatoryRequirements.contributors: Common configuration and renderer, proxy authority, Forge lifecycle and visibility adapters

ownerDecisions.question: Target platform and product scope
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Backport SEFPORTED implemented retained behavior to Forge Minecraft 1.20.1 and remove the economy and interface.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Exact interface exclusion
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Remove all interface and client-dependent surfaces so the product remains server side only. Native text, chat and visibility behavior remain governed by the explicit presentation scope.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Network topology and storage recommendation authority
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Support one Velocity proxy and three Forge backends. Storage architecture selection is delegated. Proxy-owned SQLite supplies low-volume network authority. DEC-011 selects a separate audit dataset supporting MySQL and MariaDB; DEC-010 through DEC-013 define retention and capacity behavior. Existing unrelated databases are not reused or modified implicitly.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Velocity companion product branch
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Build the Velocity companion on velocity-latest in the same repository, with backend integration on forge-1.20.1. Preserve the SEFPORTED source branch. The approved /mnt/hermes/projects/SefVelocity directory may hold the same-repository linked worktree for the applicable envy Velocity phase branch after ownership, contents and lineage checks. Preserve the owner directory and its files; this exact placement exception does not authorize a duplicate repository.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Current proxy runtime
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Java 25 is the reported proxy runtime. Verify the exact installed Velocity build during readiness rather than assuming a release from an informal latest-version description.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Current and intended backend packs
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: The three backends initially use the same modpack. Support differing packs within the approved compatible-client boundary in DEC-007.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Boundary for different modpacks
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Approved. Standalone SEF runs on one Forge server without Velocity, Ambassador, ProxyCompatibleForge or a client reset mod. These are optional deployment dependencies, required only by the explicitly selected Ambassador network profile. In that profile use Ambassador on the proxy and ProxyCompatibleForge on Forge backends, with owner-linked Forge Client Reset Packet Forward file 4657349 as the pinned external Forge 1.20.1 client compatibility adapter for in-session proxy switching. If the configured Ambassador network cannot verify the matching SEF Velocity companion, give operators manifest-backed download or connection guidance and fence network operations; never prompt in standalone mode or infer proven absence from a timeout. Keep SEF itself server-only: no SEF client module or launcher project. Support different modpacks only when the running client's actually negotiated profile and a direction-specific real transfer prove compatibility; safely refuse missing reset capability, incompatible or unknown profiles before moving the player, with a clear explanation. Installing a reset adapter does not dynamically install arbitrary pack content or guarantee every mod can reset.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Audit functionality and destructive restoration scope
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Include comprehensive CoreProtect-style functionality and the additional approved network and modded coverage. Rollback, restore and undo are mandatory. Enumerate and version functional parity, prove feasible supported capabilities, and report opaque or unavailable coverage honestly.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Public and private content
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Capture full public and private message content and command arguments, with credential redaction before all sinks and separately restricted staff access to protected content.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Normal audit retention default
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Make retention configurable, with manual purge as the normal default.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Supported external audit database engines
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: MariaDB alongside MySQL. MySQL is the primary current target. No PostgreSQL promise.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Storage-full behavior
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Keep gameplay running during storage exhaustion. Reclaim the oldest eligible closed SEF-owned local audit segments, preserve unrelated data and authoritative state, and report actual loss or uncertainty without claiming complete history.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Audit health alerts
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Alert all operators and admins through Discord when configured or through an admin-only command display. Protect webhook credentials and sensitive history; no production message is authorized during planning.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Rich command presentation
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Redo all SEF chat command output in the supplied HuskHomes style, with calm colors, checkmarks, crosses, brackets, formatting, hover information and clickable text. Rich vanilla chat is included; custom client screens, menus, HUDs, rendering and economy remain removed.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Hierarchical shuffle-grid RTP
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Mandatory configurable local server-side RTP plus optional Velocity mode. Parent sections cycle without repetition, cycle boundaries cannot immediately repeat the last parent, and each parent's independent subcell cycle persists across parent reshuffles. Coordinates are random within selected subcells. Configurable distance from players, reservations and recent landings is never relaxed to make a request succeed.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: RTP proxy routing and strict availability
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Local mode uses current-server configured worlds only. Proxy mode chooses a suitable configured backend before applying that backend's grids. Route by MSPT, tick spikes, player capacity, incoming players, chunk work and prepared location availability. World size and capacity are separate. Brief bounded queue or unavailable is valid; silent repeats or reduced distance are not.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: When an RTP allocation consumes a section and subcell turn
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Use the delegated successful-landings-only recommendation. Reserve provisionally and durably, release only after confirmed failure or nonarrival, and quarantine uncertain arrivals until reconciliation. Preserve the shared HuskHomes-inspired command styling.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This resolved owner choice defines the implementation and acceptance boundary; the architecture applies it without adding optional scope.

ownerDecisions.question: Main-configuration lifecycle message editing and variation
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Provide a server-side lifecycle message editor in the main configuration, with separate join, leave, first welcome and welcome-back families, variants and safe placeholders including {player_name}. Preserve the shared rich-chat style and complete custom-interface exclusion.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Main-config templates provide editable lifecycle messages without adding a custom interface. Shared rendering and existing authority/visibility precede their network implementation.
